title: release-cadence-weekly-triage-notes
content:
Weekly Release Cadence & Hotfix Triage — notes (working doc)

Date: 2026-03-10
Facilitator: Aisha Patel
Attendees: Aisha Patel, Marco Ruiz, Evelyn Chen, Samir Desai, Priya Nambiar, QA: Jordan Lee (joined for QA section)
Absent: None
Location: #release-cadence-triage (Slack) / Zoom

Purpose:
- Quick alignment on ongoing release train (v1.14) and outstanding hotfix candidates.
- Decide next steps for two priority regressions surfaced in staging and a user-facing bug in production.
- Capture action items for engineering, QA, and SRE to unblock scheduled canary on Thursday.

Agenda:
1) Hotfix candidates & triage summary (Samir)
2) Release v1.14 status and blockers (Marco)
3) Canary rollout plan and observability gates (Evelyn + SRE)
4) Branching/merge policy reminders and cherry-pick plan (Aisha)
5) Action items + next check-in

1) Hotfix triage summary (Samir)
- Hotfix A: oauth-token-refresh failure causing ~0.02% 5xx in hosted API (seen in prod at 2026-03-09 17:40 UTC). Jira RI-3421. Reproducer: race in token cache during parallel refresh.
  - Root cause hypothesis: token cache eviction race when two requests simultaneously refresh token for same customer.
  - Candidate fix: add per-customer refresh lock + small backoff (PR: serving-runtime PR #2481). PR currently in review; needs unit tests and stress test in staging.
  - Priority: high-production (roll-forwardable if validated in staging).

- Hotfix B: embedding indexer occasionally times out on large document batches -> causes delayed indexing and inconsistent embeddings. Affects background job processors.
  - Root cause hypothesis: memory pressure on dedicated indexer pod when shard compaction runs concurrently.
  - Proposed mitigations: 1) lower compaction concurrency; 2) increase JVM heap for indexer for next deploy.
  - Priority: medium; schedule for next minor patch if not blocking release.

2) Release v1.14 status and blockers (Marco)
- Current target: v1.14.0 release train (branch: release/v1.14.0) scheduled for canary Thursday 2026-03-12 14:00 UTC.
- Already merged: 18 PRs (perf improvements, telemetry, two model-variant handlers).
- Blockers:
  - PR #2481 (oauth token race) -> blocks canary if not deployed as hotfix on prod.
  - E2E test flake in chat-regressions suite (test: chat-history-truncate) failing intermittently; causes CI gate failures before tagging.
- Decisions:
  - If PR #2481 passes staging smoke and stress by Wed 23:00 UTC, we will include it in canary as a hotfix cherry-pick into release/v1.14.0. Otherwise, roll canary without it and enable defensive routing to fallback model variant for impacted customers.
  - QA will add a flaky-test guard for chat-history-truncate to avoid blocking the tag (see QA action items).

3) Canary rollout plan & observability gates (Evelyn + SRE)
- Canary window: 2 hours, starting 2026-03-12 14:00 UTC
- Canary population: 2% traffic on hosted API across US-West and EU-West regions; exclude enterprise reserved clusters.
- Observability gates (primary):
  - 5xx rate increase > +0.05% absolute over baseline for >10m -> abort
  - p95 latency increase > +30% over baseline for >15m -> rollback
  - Token refresh 5xx occurrence -> immediate mitigation (roll-forward/rollback decision)
  - Error budget burn for route 'chat-stream' > 5% -> abort
- SRE runbook reminder: On canary abort, route traffic back to previous model variant and scale down new pods. Postmortem mailing list: release-postmortems@redwood.com

4) Branching & cherry-pick policy refresh (Aisha)
- Policy reminder: Hotfixes that impact production stability may be cherry-picked onto release/* and main as needed. Use the branch naming convention: hotfix/short-description/YYMMDD (e.g., hotfix/oauth-token-race-230310).
- Cherry-pick checklist to attach to PR description (required):
  - Link to Jira ticket, minimal repro, risk statement, rollback steps, QA verification steps, performance notes.
- Action: Marco to create a templated checklist file in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATES/hotfix-template.md by 2026-03-11 EOD.

5) Testing & QA plan (Jordan via QA notes)
- Staging stress test for oauth token fix: 1,000 concurrent token refresh flows for 30m. Must pass with zero token refresh 5xx and stable CPU/heap.
- E2E flaky test mitigation: add @flaky decorator and create a ticket to rework chat-history truncation logic (RI-3493). For today’s release, mark test as quarantined to unblock gating.

Open questions / discussion points:
- Do we enable graceful rollout fallback for enterprise reserved clusters? (Decision: No — reserved clusters must be scheduled separately; we'll notify account owners.)
- Should we increase default token refresh backoff to more conservative value globally? Marco to evaluate cost/perf impact; decision deferred to next week.

Action items (owners & due dates):
- Samir: finish unit tests + stress test for PR #2481, update PR description with benchmark numbers. Due: 2026-03-11 23:59 UTC.
- Marco: create hotfix PR checklist template in repo (.github). Due: 2026-03-11 EOD.
- Evelyn: validate canary observability dashboards and add one-button abort on the canary job. Due: 2026-03-12 10:00 UTC.
- Jordan (QA): run staging stress test for oauth fix and report results in ticket RI-3421. Due: 2026-03-11 12:00 UTC.
- Priya (SRE): prepare rollback runbook snippet for oauth token issue and publish to runbooks/release-runbooks.md. Due: 2026-03-11 18:00 UTC.
- Aisha: if PR #2481 misses staging gate, prepare a routing mitigation playbook and notify account owners. Due: 2026-03-11 23:30 UTC.

Notes / meeting artifacts:
- Temporary experiment: enabling indexer compaction backoff for only replicated shards to reduce mem pressure (will be toggled via feature flag).
- Observed anomaly: small spike in 5xx correlating with customer X churn (customer id redacted). Samir to add correlation markers in tracing.
- Meeting draft of canary announcement to internal channels compiled by Evelyn (will post to #infra-ops and #customer-incident-ops once go/no-go decided).

Next check-in:
- Quick sync Wed 2026-03-11 09:30 UTC (15-min) to validate staging results and confirm canary decision.

Notes to self / TODOs:
- Follow up with product on whether chat-history truncation can be relaxed for now as temporary mitigation.
- Add a short blurb for sales/CS if hotfix is included in canary (impact messaging).

Appendix: Relevant links
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/2481
- Jira: https://jira.internal/browse/RI-3421
- Canary runbook (draft): https://confluence.internal/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=67248
- Slack thread (captures initial customer report): slack://channel?team=T01234567&id=release-cadence-triage

End of notes (working doc)

-- Aisha
